name: Pledged Fist
description: Throw a fist backed by a pledge made under the sky and let the weight of the promise finish the blow.

name: Pledged Guard
description: Hold the guard in the pledged posture and let a shell of will stand where the pledge was made.

name: Pledged Pace
description: Stride on toward the pledged mark and let no hand or word make the step shorter.

name: Pledge Stand
description: Hold the pledge aloud while a shell of will takes blow after blow and the speaker does not give way.

name: Pledge Lend
description: Share the pledge with the allies near and lend each of them a measure of the user's unbending will.

name: Pledge Unbinding
description: Speak the pledge over an ally held by a hostile will and loosen the hold on their mind a knot at a time.

name: Pledge Sunder
description: Break a guard and the arm behind it with a single blow that carries a whole pledge in its weight.

name: Pledged Mantle
description: Stand over the nearby allies and shelter them under a pledged will that braces each of them against harm.

name: Zenith Pledge
description: Raise the pledge to its highest point and loose it as a bolt of will that pierces the foe and presses down their qi.

name: Crowned Fist
description: Throw a fist that sits atop a layered resolve and lands with the weight of all the layers beneath it.

name: Crowned Guard
description: Hold the guard high and layer the resolve upward in rings so a blow breaks on each ring in turn.

name: Crowned Stride
description: Stride with the head held proud and the layered resolve carrying the body from heel to heel.

name: Crowned Voice
description: Speak a single high word to an ally and lay a layer of resolve over their own shaking will.

name: Crowning Press
description: Bear down on the opponent with the full layered resolve until their qi flattens and their stance sinks.

name: Crowning Ward
description: Stack ring on ring of will round the body until the whole shell turns blows and holds its form.

name: Crowned Clarity
description: Lay a clear crowning resolve over an ally and push out the fear or taint that has settled in their mind.

name: Crowning Blow
description: Drop the whole crowned resolve into one blow that lands on the opponent like a weight from above.

name: Crowning Rise
description: Raise a person whose heart has just stopped with the whole crowned resolve poured into their chest.

name: Resolve Ascendant
description: Bring the crowned resolve to its height and strike the foe's mind directly with a pure force that no armour or guard can stop.

name: Mandate Fist
description: Strike on a clear mandate with a fist that does the work the authority gives it and no more.

name: Mandate Guard
description: Command the qi to guard the body and see the command carried out at once.

name: Mandate Stride
description: Move on a clear mandate in a single measured stride that crosses the gap at the moment named.

name: Mandate Sense
description: Send the mandate out like a call and feel which minds answer it with obedience and which with defiance.

name: Mandate Spur
description: Give an ally the mandate to act and let the authority behind it free their hands and their nerve.

name: Mandate Hold
description: Order the opponent to stand still and see the mandate close round their limbs until it is withdrawn.

name: Mandate Rebuke
description: Rebuke an attack by mandate so it turns aside and strike the attacker as the rebuke lands.

name: Mandate Release
description: Withdraw a hostile mandate from an ally by asserting a prior one and clearing their mind of it.

name: Mandate Crash
description: Strike with the full weight of the mandate so the blow lands and the opponent's qi is driven to the floor.

name: Mandate Sweep
description: Sweep a wide mandate across the field so that every foe within it is struck back and made to kneel.

name: Azure Mandate
description: Issue the highest mandate over the whole field so every foe in it is pressed down and struck by the weight of command.

name: Keen Fist
description: Mark a single point with a sharp eye and strike it with a fist that does not wander.

name: Keen Guard
description: Watch the blow come with a keen eye and meet it with a hardened guard at the exact spot.

name: Keen Stride
description: Stride along a line picked out by the eye and the will with no wasted pace.

name: Keen Sight
description: Fix a keen intent on the field and see through it every mind that means to strike.

name: Keen Lance
description: Launch a lance of will at the one point the eye has chosen so it hits and rattles the concentration.

name: Keen Brace
description: Brace the body at the one point the eye says will be struck and thicken the will there.

name: Hawk Stoop
description: Fall onto the marked foe from a height with the whole will behind the strike like a hawk onto prey.

name: Keen Thrust
description: Gather the intent to a single point and send it through every layer of guard to the one marked.

name: Piercing Intent
description: Pierce the marked foe with a thread of pure intent that passes every guard and strikes at the self within.

name: Judged Fist
description: Pass a judgment in the mind and carry it out in the fist with no second thought.

name: Judged Guard
description: Judge the blow harmless and let a cool shell of will make the judgment true.

name: Judged Stride
description: Judge the shortest line and take it in one cold unhurried stride.

name: Judged Calm
description: Pass a cool judgment into an ally's mind so that heat and panic fall away from their thinking.

name: Judged Reading
description: Judge a stranger's mind in a cold glance and know how far their intent can be trusted.

name: Judged Press
description: Hold the opponent under a judgment until the weight of it settles on their qi and their limbs.

name: Judged Shield
description: Judge the incoming force unfit to pass and hold a cold shell of will against it.

name: Judged Rebuke
description: Judge the attack at fault and return its force to the attacker through a film of will.

name: Judged Clearing
description: Judge a taint on an ally's mind to be false and strike it out with the force of the judgment.

name: Judged Fall
description: Bring the judgment down as one blow that strikes the foe and presses their will under the sentence.

name: Judged Wave
description: Pass judgment on a group of foes at once and send the sentence out as a pulse that staggers them.

name: Pale Verdict
description: Hand down a cold final verdict that strikes the foe's will directly and cannot be softened by armour or distance.

name: Bound Fist
description: Throw a fist bound to an oath so that the blow cannot fall short of what was sworn.

name: Bound Guard
description: Bind the guard to the oath and let it hold firmer than any guard held by habit.

name: Bound Stride
description: Stride on as the oath requires and refuse to stop for the pain in the legs.

name: Bound Spur
description: Remind an ally of the oath they share and spur their will to stand on it.

name: Bound Press
description: Press the oath into the opponent with a strike that lands and weighs down their qi.

name: Bound Ward
description: Hold a ward of will bound to the oath that stiffens as the force against it increases.

name: Bound Release
description: Release an ally from a false oath or a compelled one by speaking the true oath over it.

name: Bound Hammer
description: Drive the whole sworn weight into one blow that hammers down the guard of the oath-breaker.

name: Bound Rally
description: Call the oath aloud to every ally in reach and wrap them in a shared shell of sworn will.

name: Reckoning Sworn
description: Call down the full reckoning of a broken oath on the foe so their will is struck directly and pressed to the ground.

name: Squall Fist
description: Throw a fist in the sudden fury of a squall with a will held perfectly calm at the centre.

name: Squall Guard
description: Stand calm in the centre of the guard while a shell of will whirls round the body and breaks blows.

name: Squall Stride
description: Stride across the field in a rush of will that arrives before the dust it raises settles.

name: Squall Surge
description: Surge outward in a ring of will so that every foe near the user is shoved back and shaken.

name: Squall Calm
description: Hold a calm place in the wind for the nearby allies and lend them the still will at its core.

name: Squall Purge
description: Blow a clear wind of will through an ally's mind and carry off the fear or foreign pressure in it.

name: Squall Breaker
description: Break through a guard with a blow carrying a squall's fury and a will that does not waver.

name: Squall Hush
description: Hush the whole field under a pressing will so the foes near are struck still and silent.

name: Tempest Will
description: Loose the full storm of will over the field so every foe is struck down and every ally stands calm in it.

name: Obstinate Fist
description: Drive a fist forward with a will that will not turn back whatever stands in the line.

name: Stubborn Guard
description: Plant the stance and refuse to give the ground the blow wants with a shell of obstinate will.

name: Stubborn Stride
description: Stride into a hard wind without bending and gain a full pace on it.

name: Stubborn Lend
description: Lend an ally a portion of the obstinate will so that they too refuse to be pushed back.

name: Stubborn Ear
description: Listen with a patient will to a crowd and pick out the one mind that means harm.

name: Stubborn Press
description: Press on the opponent with an obstinate weight that does not lift until their qi has sunk.

name: Stubborn Brace
description: Brace the whole body on an unmoving will and let the incoming force exhaust itself against it.

name: Stubborn Counter
description: Take a strike on the unyielding frame and send the full force of it back along its own line.

name: Stubborn Clearing
description: Refuse a hostile will on an ally's behalf and push it out of their mind by sheer stubbornness.

name: Stubborn Hammer
description: Hammer the same spot with the same stubborn blow until the guard and the arm behind it give up.

name: Stubborn Shield
description: Stand before the nearby allies and spread an obstinate shell of will over all of them at once.

name: Stubborn Revival
description: Refuse the death of a person who has just fallen and hold the will on them until the breath returns.

name: Unyielding Gale
description: Raise a wind of will that turns back every force sent against the user and sweeps the foes away on its return.

name: Candid Fist
description: Throw an unhidden fist straight from the shoulder with a will that conceals nothing.

name: Candid Shield
description: Hold the guard in plain view and let the open will thicken it where the blow will fall.

name: Candid Stride
description: Walk out in full sight and cross the gap with a will that hides no direction.

name: Candid Word
description: Speak the plain truth to a doubting ally and let the honesty of it firm their courage.

name: Candid Order
description: Give a plain order in the open that the opponent's body obeys against its better sense for a breath.

name: Candid Hold
description: Hold a shell of unhidden will over the user that shows its strength and gives way to nothing.

name: Candid Unbinding
description: Speak the truth to an ally under a false compulsion and let it dissolve the lie in their mind.

name: Candid Decree
description: Proclaim a plain decree across the field and press every foe who hears it down beneath its weight.

name: Candid Blow
description: Deliver an honest blow with no feint and the whole weight of an unhidden will.

name: Unveiled Command
description: Speak a command with nothing held back so that its plain weight presses every foe in hearing flat to the ground.

name: Headwind Fist
description: Throw a fist into the teeth of the wind and let the resistance sharpen the will behind it.

name: Headwind Guard
description: Lean the guard into the oncoming force and gain firmness from the push against it.

name: Headwind Stride
description: Stride into the pushing air and win ground against it a pace at a time.

name: Headwind Calm
description: Hold a steady will beside an ally who is being pushed back and let them draw strength from it.

name: Headwind Ear
description: Face the resistance and read from its grain which minds ahead are set against the user.

name: Headwind Press
description: Lean on the opponent with an advancing will that gains force with every pace it wins.

name: Headwind Hold
description: Stand against a rising force and let the shell of will harden as the pressure rises.

name: Headwind Clearing
description: Walk an ally through a clinging dread and clear it from their mind a step at a time.

name: Headwind Crush
description: Drive forward against all resistance and land a blow that crushes the guard and presses the qi flat.

name: Headwind Rally
description: Rally every ally nearby with an advancing will that braces them against whatever pushes them back.

name: Resolve Unturned
description: Advance on the foe with a resolve that cannot be turned and strike the will within with a pure unblockable force.
